resolution.note: lane run hardened: model pin, retry reuse, ticket title, closed-task and check gates

title: krn lane run is ready for the task-record experiment
body:
Why: an independent review found krn lane run unsafe for the task-record experiment: no pinned model, retries bounce, wrong PR title and empty verification, ships tasks left open.
Outcome: lane run pins the model, is retry-safe, titles the PR from the Ticket commit, ships only a closed task with a passing check on the final tree.
Proof: test/cli/lane-run.test.ts.
